nj-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its county commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the office looking empty.
nj-county-officials.why: No statewide list of New Jersey's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
nj-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners, clerk, sheriff and surrogate, or a county's own published list of them.

nj-municipal-officeholders.summary: The Municipality card names the municipality you picked, and not its mayor or governing body.
nj-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of New Jersey's municipalities has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
nj-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each municipality's mayor and governing body, or a municipality's own published list of them.

nj-school-board-members.summary: The three School District cards name the districts you picked, and not the members of their boards of education.
nj-school-board-members.why: No list of the board of education members of New Jersey's school districts has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
nj-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board of education members, or a district's own published list of its board.
